_note: DRAFT for The Völva to rewrite in her own words before launch. Two lines per centre: 'lit' when the week's sky switches a centre on that the chart leaves open, 'open' when it stays open all week. Everything else in Body Weather comes from lib/corpus.json.

Head.lit: Questions arrive with more pressure than usual. Many of them stay questions; not every one is yours to answer this week.
Head.open: Other people's questions can feel urgent in your head. Some of them belong to someone else entirely.

Ajna.lit: Thought runs in a fixed track for a few days. Decisions feel solid now, and often look different once the sky moves on.
Ajna.open: You can hold several views at once. Certainty is slow to form, and that slowness is part of the gift.

Throat.lit: Words come easily and want out. What has been waiting finds its way out, and silences feel harder to leave empty.
Throat.open: You may feel pressure to speak to be seen. Words land most when the room turns to you.

G.lit: Direction feels clear for a while. Steps along it come easily, and the clarity is the week's as much as yours.
G.open: Places and people steer you more than usual. Some rooms simply feel right, and that feeling carries the direction.

Heart.lit: Willpower is on loan. It gathers behind one promise rather than spreading into proving things.
Heart.open: Nothing to prove this week. Worth sits quietly, with no promise needed to earn it.

Spleen.lit: Instinct speaks quickly and only once, clearest the first time.
Spleen.open: The familiar pulls strongly, and the body knows whether it is still good for you.

Solar.lit: Feelings run in a wave for a few days. Clarity arrives with the wave and settles over days.
Solar.open: You'll feel other people's moods strongly. Away from a heated room, what was yours comes clear.

Sacral.lit: There's more energy in the body for a while. It flows most freely into work your gut says yes to.
Sacral.open: Borrowed energy runs out suddenly. The current runs high and spends fast.

Root.lit: Pressure to get things moving. It gathers behind one beginning while the rest keeps.
Root.open: Other people's hurry lands in you. The pressure moves through you, and action still comes clean.
